_readme: Clothing. {color} in a prompt is replaced with the color picked for her (colors are listed at the bottom with their swatch hex).

base: generic starting outfits (also sold in the shop). shop: shop-only outfits. Each: label, style (Elegant, Cute, Exotic, Sporty, Revealing), cost, lewd (lewdness she needs to wear it), prompt, bonus.
bonus multiplies income: jobs (maid, promoter, attendant, bartender, dancer, bath, courtesan, madame, security), client classes (commoner, adventurer, merchant, noble) or propose (propositions).
under: undergarments, same fields. Keep the ids plain and none; none (commando) is special-cased.
Named ladies' signature outfits live with them in characters.json.
uniform: an outfit tagged with a job (b_maid) is never rolled for generic ladies; she wears it automatically while she holds that job, unless she has a job outfit set (w.jobOutfit[job]).
